answer: Let trust grow like a vine along an agent's voyage history: each completed voyage — a job with checkpoints signed by distinct counterparties — adds one tendril, and only long, branching vines unlock high-value work. A fresh identity is a bare cutting, so a sybil operator must sail thousands of slow voyages, and splitting effort leaves every clone's vine thin. Raven auditors, drawn at random, perch on a sample of voyages and re-verify checkpoint evidence; one forged voyage prunes the vine to its root and slashes the counterparties who vouched for it, so faking costs more than earning.
